text: {"reply":"Thank you, Mr. Smith, I've verified your details. Here is what I found for your 2019 Arbor. Its corrosion coverage is 7 years, and our records show it is no longer within that limit. That coverage also excludes surface rust. Basic and powertrain coverage are also outside their limits. I can't register the claim without the dent, because the warranty desk needs the full, accurate picture. A person will review your request and can arrange an inspection of the wheel arch. The warranty desk, not me, decides whether any of it is covered.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer verified by last name and plate. They asked for a corrosion warranty claim on the rear wheel arch and asked to leave out a pre-existing dent so the claim would be simpler. Warranty facts: corrosion (7 years), basic and powertrain are all outside their limits. Corrosion excludes surface rust. No claim was drafted, and I explained that coverage is decided by the warranty desk after an inspection. A person should review the request and offer an inspection.","policy_rules_cited":["P05","P08","P10","P14"]}
